modules.name: Movie Title Links
features: Full-screen Now Playing info card auto-triggered on title change — backdrop, poster, title/year, rating, runtime, genres, synopsis
IMDb / Letterboxd / Wikipedia badge links
Color-coded parental-guide content-warning chips
Floating stats strip + I hotkey to reopen the card
Fix a wrong movie match: 'Matched as' line + pencil on the Now Playing card opens a search-and-pin modal; per-filename override persists

modules.name: IMDb Trivia
features: "Trivia" button appears once a movie is identified
Opens a floating panel of real IMDb trivia facts (T hotkey too)
Cached per-title

modules.name: Pop-up Trivia Bubbles
features: VH1 Pop-up Video style trivia bubbles auto-appear every few minutes during movie playback
Reuses the same IMDb trivia already fetched for the Trivia panel, plus (movies only) trivia and "also known for" facts about the top cast and director
Cycles without repeats; stops for the rest of that movie once every fact has been shown
Off by default — opt in from Settings

modules.name: Last Aired Date
features: Shows when a movie last aired on the channel, sourced from the host's spreadsheet
Appears in both the floating stats strip and the full Now Playing card

modules.name: Weekend Grindhouse Schedule
features: Full-screen "Coming Attractions" overlay with Friday/Saturday/Sunday tabs
Each night's themed blocks get distinct color/font, with poster art for every film
Glowing NOW PLAYING badge + dims already-shown films; click a poster to open its Now Playing card
Optional experimental ETA timing toggle

modules.name: TMDB Metadata
features: Optional free API key makes TMDB the primary source for title/rating/runtime/overview/genres/art (IMDb is the no-key fallback)
Adds a kill-count chip from a community horror database
Live key-validation Test button

modules.name: Grammar Check
features: Checks chat messages for grammar/spelling/mixed-up words via LanguageTool before sending (3s timeout, never blocks send)
Flags ALL-CAPS, keyyysmash, excessive punctuation
Inline review popup with click-to-fix suggestions
Skips @mentions, #hashtags, and URLs
Icon button in the chat box's bottom-left corner (mirroring the emote button) toggles the check on/off without opening Settings

modules.name: Emote Image Cache
features: Caches every channel emote's image in Cache Storage instead of relying on the browser's shared HTTP cache, which gets evicted constantly by ordinary chat/gif traffic
Stops emotes from re-downloading and rate-limiting the CDN when scrolling the emote picker or viewing them in chat
Stays fresh via the channel's live emote add/edit/remove events, plus an on-demand top-up whenever the emote picker panel opens

modules.name: Emote Picker
features: Redesigned draggable emote panel — position remembered
Live search/filter, star-to-favorite with a pinned favorites row
Larger tiles with per-tile loading spinners, click-to-insert
Right-click a chat emote to ban it — it shows as its plain #name text instead, personal to your browser
Adapts to vertical/horizontal layout

modules.name: Chat Formatting Toolbar
features: Small “Aa” button beside the emote button opens a pop-up toolbar of CyTube chat-markup shortcuts
Italic / bold / monospace / strikethrough wrap the highlighted text (or drop the markers at the cursor); click again to unwrap
Greentext, /me and /sp buttons prefix the current line or the whole message
Closes on click-away or Esc; focus returns to the chat box after each insert

modules.name: Embedded Chat Images
features: Auto-embeds inline image previews under chat messages linking directly to images
Also resolves image-hosting landing pages (postimg.cc, ibb.co, prnt.sc) that don't link directly to an image
Per-image toggle between thumbnail/link view
Per-user "hide"/"unban" mute for specific image URLs
Keeps chat scrolled to bottom as embeds load

modules.name: Chat Link Picture-in-Picture
features: Adds a 🗗 icon next to YouTube links in chat that opens a floating picture-in-picture player
Auto-mutes the main player while a YouTube PiP plays, restoring its previous state on close

modules.name: IMDb Link Preview
features: Hovering an imdb.com/title/ link posted in chat shows a floating poster/title/rating/description card
Hover-intent delay avoids firing a lookup for every link the mouse passes over while scrolling
Cached per-title for the session so repeat hovers don't re-hit the network

modules.name: Simkl Scrobble Prompt
features: At the end of a movie, a dark semi-transparent card appears at the bottom-right of the video for a minute offering to log the watch on simkl.com
Optional 1–10 rating sent with the watch in a single call; sign in to Simkl right from the card (device code — no secret to manage)
Uses your own free Simkl app Client ID from Settings; prompt point is configurable (default 90% of the movie)
Press Alt+S at any time to open the card for the current movie (handy for testing); Settings has a Simkl section with a Test connection (Connect & verify) button
Movies only (not YouTube / TV episodes); off by default — opt in from Settings

modules.name: Movie Sync Adjustment
features: Keeps local playback a few seconds ahead of the group's synced position during movies (not YouTube)
So your own buffering doesn't drop you out of sync
Adjustable 0-10s lead time via settings-modal field, 0 = off

modules.name: Playback Recovery
features: Detects a network error killing playback (common right after a page reload) and auto-reloads just the video, resuming from where it was
Shows a small "Reconnecting…" indicator while it retries, up to 3 attempts
Falls back to a manual click-to-retry indicator if it still can't recover

modules.name: Subtitle Support
features: Load a local .srt/.vtt file, synced via native browser captions
Fine-tune offset with quick buttons/keyboard shortcuts
Adjustable caption size + drag-to-position on screen (both persisted)
With a free OpenSubtitles API key: search & one-click load real subtitles for the movie playing now, right in the panel
One-click external OpenSubtitles search; auto-restores your subtitles for ~6h per movie

modules.name: Up Next
features: Shows the channel's schedule/queue dashboard from a header button
Shows a friendly message in the panel if that dashboard can't load

modules.name: GIF Maker
features: Capture any scene from the playing video as an animated GIF via a floating button
Scrubbable filmstrip with start/end handles
Meme-style top/bottom captions (color/shadow/wiggle) + effects (reverse, boomerang, speed, deep-fry, VHS, zoom-shake)
Adjustable FPS/width/aspect; download or one-click upload to ImgBB for a shareable link
